logp.method_description: Partition coefficient (cLog P) was measured using the shake-flask method for four ruthenium complexes in the octanol-water system [43]. 2 mL of 1-octanol and 2 mL of PBS containing ruthenium complexes were mixed and shaken constantly for 10 h at 37 °C on a shaking incubator to obtain full distribution between the two layers. After that, all samples were left undisturbed for two hours. The absorbance in octanol was measured with a UV–vis spectrophotometer. Experiments were replicated three times. The cLog P was calculated by the ratio of octanol and water.
